item.name: Record a model call on CLM-1005, not started

request.description: `record_model_call`: refused on a claim nobody has started.
`list_steps`: the steps in order.
`decide_claim`: an approval at or under $1,000 stays in progress until it is paid.
`pay_claim`: pays the approved payout.
`pay_claim`: the same payment again, as after a restart, is done: it returns the claim, paid once.
`pay_claim`: a different amount on a paid claim is refused.
`decide_claim`: the same decision again, as after a restart, is done: it returns the claim with one decision.
`list_claims` carries each claim's latest decision, payout and payment.
`start_claim`: start a waiting claim in the run.
`decide_claim`: an approval over $1,000 waits for sign-off.
`pay_claim` is refused over $1,000, even if the agent tries.

exec: pm.test("refused", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("A payout over $1,000.00 waits for a handler's sign-off"));

request.description: `review_payout`: a rejection needs a note that says what's wrong, which goes back to the agent.

item.name: Sign off CLM-1002 as Dana Whitfield

request.description: `review_payout`: a handler signs off the held payout. The claim goes back in progress for the agent to pay, and the backend asks the agent's service to pick it up.

exec: pm.test("back in progress for the agent", () => pm.expect(["in_progress", "decided"]).to.include(claim.status));
pm.test("signed off by Dana Whitfield", () => { const d = claim.decisions[claim.decisions.length - 1]; pm.expect(d.review).to.eql("signed_off"); pm.expect(d.reviewed_by).to.eql("HND-01"); });

request.description: `pay_claim`: the agent pays the signed-off payout, and the payment records the sign-off. If the agent's service paid it first, the same payment is a repeat and returns the claim.

exec: pm.test("authorized by Dana Whitfield, with the sign-off's time", () => { pm.expect(claim.payment.authorized_by).to.eql("HND-01"); pm.expect(claim.payment.signed_off_at).to.be.a("string"); });

request.description: `start_claim`: start a waiting claim in the run.
`decide_claim`: a referral waits for a handler.
`decide_as_handler`: a handler approves the referred claim, which pays it.

item.name: Runs
item.description: Run after the Workflow folder, on fresh data: the run's to-do list, usage, a failed claim and the finish.

request.description: `record_run_claims`: the claims the dispatch works, in order.

item.name: Record an unknown claim with the dispatch

request.description: `record_run_claims`: 404 for a claim that isn't there.
`start_claim`: start a waiting claim in the run.
`fail_claim`: work on the claim failed; it goes back in the queue.
`get_latest_dispatch`: the dispatch, with its claims, their work and its cost.

exec: pm.test("the model call recorded in the Workflow folder", () => pm.expect(run.usage.cost).to.eql(0.0042));

request.description: `finish_run`: finish the dispatch; the backend builds its summary from the records.

exec: pm.test("CLM-1004 is left for the next dispatch", () => pm.expect(run.summary.unfinished).to.eql(["CLM-1004"]));

request.description: `finish_run`: 409 for a dispatch that has finished.
`stop_runs`: marks every run still running stopped, as the agent's service does when it starts.

item.name: Start a dispatch with no claim agents

request.description: `start_dispatch`: 422 for N below 1, before the agent's service is asked. A start with N from 1 to 25 starts a real dispatch, which calls the model, so the collection doesn't send one.
`stop_run`: the agent's service says nothing is running (409), or the backend says the service isn't running (503).

item.name: Create an evaluation of the held-out tiny claims

request.description: `create_evaluation`: an evaluation, as the agent's service records one, with its copies of the held-out set's five tiny claims.

item.name: The copy is out of the queue

request.description: `list_claims`: the queue holds its 25 claims and no copy.
`review_payout`: refused on an evaluation's copy, which nobody signs off or rejects.

exec: pm.test("a copy", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.include("is a copy in an evaluation"));

request.description: `finish_run`: finish the evaluation.
`get_evaluation`: the evaluation with its measures, each copy beside the handler's decision.

exec: pm.test("nothing decided, so every copy is a referral", () => pm.expect(evaluation.measures.straight_through).to.eql(0));
pm.test("five copies beside the handlers", () => pm.expect(evaluation.claims.map((c) => c.handler_decision).length).to.eql(5));

request.description: `list_evaluations`: every evaluation, newest first, with its measures.

item.name: Start an evaluation of an unknown set

request.description: `start_evaluation`: 422 for a set that isn't one, before the agent's service is asked. A real start calls the model, so the collection doesn't send one.

item.name: Insights
item.description: Run after the Workflow folder, on fresh data: sums up what the workflow did.

request.description: `get_insights`: the agent's work on the queue: outcomes, time, tools and money.

exec: pm.test("three claims decided by the agent", () => pm.expect(totals.decided).to.eql(3));
pm.test("one sign-off and one referral", () => { pm.expect(totals.sign_offs).to.eql(1); pm.expect(totals.referred).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("no claim waits for a handler", () => pm.expect(totals.waiting_for_handler).to.eql(0));
pm.test("the recorded step counts as a get_claim call", () => pm.expect(insights.tools).to.eql([{ tool: "get_claim", calls: 1, refused: 0 }]));

item.name: Models
item.description: Starts and stops the UnderCover Agent. Run CLM-1003 calls the local Qwen model through Ollama, for nothing, for a moment before Stop ends it.

request.description: `list_models`: the models the agent may run on, with the default marked.
